## Setup
```{r section-d-setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
packages <- c("readxl", "forecast", "dlnm", "splines", "Metrics",
              "demography", "tseries", "seastests")
invisible(lapply(packages, library, character.only = TRUE))

find_project_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  path <- normalizePath(start, mustWork = FALSE)
  for (i in seq_len(8)) {
    if (dir.exists(file.path(path, "Code")) && dir.exists(file.path(path, "Data"))) {
      return(path)
    }
    parent <- dirname(path)
    if (identical(parent, path)) break
    path <- parent
  }
  stop("Set LC_DLNM_BASE_DIR to the project root.")
}

base_dir <- Sys.getenv("LC_DLNM_BASE_DIR")
if (!nzchar(base_dir)) base_dir <- find_project_root()

function_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "Code/Function")
results_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "Results/Diagnostics")
calibration_rmd <- file.path(
  base_dir,
  "Code/Main_Paper/Section_4_Empirical_results/01_DLNM_LC_LL_calibration.Rmd"
)
calibration_results_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "Results/Calibration")
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(calibration_results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
files <- list.files(function_dir, pattern = "\\.R$", full.names = TRUE)
invisible(sapply(files, source))
```

## D.1 Optimal time series model for time-varying factors
```{r section-d-sarima-tables, results='asis', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
ensure_sarima_tables <- function() {
  required_files <- file.path(
    calibration_results_dir,
    c("optimal_sarima_table.tex", "optimal_sarima_coef_table.tex")
  )

  if (all(file.exists(required_files))) {
    return(invisible(required_files))
  }

  if (!file.exists(calibration_rmd)) {
    stop("Calibration Rmd not found: ", calibration_rmd)
  }

  old_unnamed_label <- knitr::opts_knit$get("unnamed.chunk.label")
  knitr::opts_knit$set(unnamed.chunk.label = "calibration_component")
  on.exit(knitr::opts_knit$set(unnamed.chunk.label = old_unnamed_label),
          add = TRUE)

  script <- tempfile(fileext = ".R")
  knitr::purl(calibration_rmd, output = script, quiet = TRUE)
  calibration_env <- new.env(parent = globalenv())
  invisible(capture.output(sys.source(script, envir = calibration_env)))

  if (!all(file.exists(required_files))) {
    build_sarima_tables_from_fits(
      calibration_env$b,
      calibration_env$b1,
      calibration_env$b2,
      calibration_env$b3,
      calibration_results_dir
    )
  }

  missing_files <- required_files[!file.exists(required_files)]
  if (length(missing_files) > 0) {
    stop("Could not generate SARIMA table file(s): ",
         paste(basename(missing_files), collapse = ", "))
  }

  invisible(required_files)
}

sarima_files <- ensure_sarima_tables()
cat(readLines(sarima_files[[1]]), sep = "\n")
cat("\n\n")
cat(readLines(sarima_files[[2]]), sep = "\n")
```

## Helper Functions
```{r section-d-helpers}
format_p <- function(x) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), "--", sprintf("%.2f", as.numeric(x)))
}

make_seasonality_latex <- function(test_list, display_names, model_name,
                                   caption, label) {
  region_order <- c("Attiki", "Lisbon", "Roma")
  region_order <- region_order[region_order %in% names(test_list)]
  test_rows <- c(QS = "QS",
                 Friedman = "Friedman",
                 `K--W` = "Kruskal-Wallis")

  lines <- c(
    "\\begin{table}[H]",
    "\\centering",
    "\\begin{tabular}{lccccccccc}",
    "\\toprule",
    paste0(
      "\\multirow{2}{*}{\\textbf{", model_name, "}}",
      " & \\multicolumn{3}{c}{\\textbf{", display_names[[region_order[[1]]]], "}}",
      " & \\multicolumn{3}{c}{\\textbf{", display_names[[region_order[[2]]]], "}}",
      " & \\multicolumn{3}{c}{\\textbf{", display_names[[region_order[[3]]]], "}} \\\\"
    ),
    "\\cmidrule(lr){2-4} \\cmidrule(lr){5-7} \\cmidrule(lr){8-10}",
    paste0(
      " & \\textbf{QS} & \\textbf{Friedman} & \\textbf{K--W}",
      " & \\textbf{QS} & \\textbf{Friedman} & \\textbf{K--W}",
      " & \\textbf{QS} & \\textbf{Friedman} & \\textbf{K--W} \\\\"
    ),
    "\\midrule"
  )

  for (age_group in colnames(test_list[[region_order[[1]]]])) {
    values <- c()
    for (region in region_order) {
      test_table <- test_list[[region]]
      values <- c(values, format_p(test_table[test_rows, age_group]))
    }
    age_label <- gsub("-", "--", age_group)
    lines <- c(lines, paste0(age_label, " & ", paste(values, collapse = " & "), " \\\\"))
  }

  lines <- c(
    lines,
    "\\bottomrule",
    "\\end{tabular}",
    paste0("\\caption{", caption, "}"),
    paste0("\\label{", label, "}"),
    "\\end{table}"
  )
  paste(lines, collapse = "\n")
}
```

## DLNM-LC Residual Seasonality
```{r section-d-dlnm-lc-seasonality, results='asis'}
lc_tests <- diagnostics$DLNM_LC$seasonality_tests
lc_display_names <- diagnostics$DLNM_LC$display_names

lc_latex <- make_seasonality_latex(
  lc_tests,
  lc_display_names,
  "DLNM--LC",
  "The seasonality test of model residual in DLNM--LC model.",
  "tab:seasonality_dlnm_lc"
)

writeLines(lc_latex, file.path(results_dir, "residual_seasonality_DLNM_LC.tex"))
cat(lc_latex)
```
